home.title: SharkyClips: free stream highlights to Shorts, TikTok and Reels
home.desc: SharkyClips is a free app for streamers. It finds the best moments in your stream recording and turns them into ready-to-post vertical clips, all on your own PC.
home.h1: Your stream in, ready-to-post clips out.
home.lead: SharkyClips finds the best moments in your stream recording and turns them into vertical clips for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels. It all runs on your own PC.
home.hero_alt: SharkyClips in Easy mode: a stream with its ready clips and one Share button for each
home.how_lead: Three steps. SharkyClips does the editing work in between.

steps.p: Drop a video file, or paste a Twitch, YouTube or Kick link. SharkyClips can also take the newest recording from your OBS folder.
It finds the loud, funny and exciting moments, cuts them cleanly, adds subtitles, bleeps swear words and writes titles.
Watch the clips, change what you like, and share them to YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels.

cards.p: Loud reactions, laughter, chat explosions and in-game events become one ranked list of clips.
Swear words are bleeped in 11 languages, and every finished clip is listened to again.
YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels, with the right caption and limits for each.
A small browser extension fills in your TikTok upload. You check it and click Post yourself.
Turn 2 to 20 photos into a vertical before-and-after video with labels and music.
Four looks for the app, dark and light, and your own colours.

home.yt_html:
Uploading to YouTube is optional. If you connect your channel in Settings → YouTube, SharkyClips uses the official YouTube API Services to do exactly these things, and only when you ask for them:

ActionPermission (scope)When
Upload a clip you set up (title, description, tags, privacy, release time, playlist, thumbnail); change its details or release time, publish it early or delete it when you cancel it before it is public; show which channel is connected; read the views, likes and privacy status of videos uploaded with SharkyClipsyoutubeWhen you press Publish now or schedule a clip (uploaded in advance while your PC is on), edit or cancel it in the Library, open Settings, and about every 6 hours while the app runs
Read the average view percentage of those same videos, to learn which opening (hook) style keeps your viewers watchingyt-analytics.readonlyOnly for clips uploaded as part of a hook test, once they have been public for 48 hours

This data is stored only on your computer and is used only to show you your results and to improve the clip scores for your channel. SharkyClips has no server: the developers never receive, see or share your YouTube data, and nothing is used for ads. SharkyClips never reads other people's channels, your comments, your subscribers or your watch history. It only changes or deletes videos that were uploaded with SharkyClips, and only when you ask (for example when you edit or cancel a scheduled clip).

You can disconnect at any time in Settings → YouTube (this revokes the access token at Google), or remove the access in your Google account permissions. By connecting you agree to the YouTube Terms of Service; Google handles your data under the Google Privacy Policy. Read our full privacy policy and terms of use.
home.oss_p: SharkyClips is MIT-licensed: no subscription, no credits, no watermark. There is no account and no tracking, and your videos stay on your PC unless you share them. The source code and every release are on GitHub.

download.title: Download SharkyClips for Windows (free)
download.desc: Download the free SharkyClips installer for Windows 10 and 11. System requirements, install steps and help with the Windows SmartScreen message.
download.lead: One installer with everything inside. No administrator rights, no extra programs.

steps.p: Click the download button. The file is called SharkyClips-Setup-{version}.exe.
Open it and click Next, then Install. It takes about a minute. Does Windows show a blue message? See below.
SharkyClips opens in your browser, asks for your language and checks your PC. Then it downloads the AI parts that fit your PC, once.

download.req_p: SharkyClips checks your hardware at every start and picks the fastest setup that works.
req_rows: 8 GB RAM (4 GB works in Light mode, slowly)
NVIDIA GPU with 6 GB or more
About 3 GB for the app and 2 to 10 GB for the AI models
An SSD, plus room for your videos
For the first start and for sharing
download.smart_p: The installer is not signed with a paid certificate yet, so Microsoft Defender SmartScreen may warn about a new download. This is normal for new free apps.
smart_steps: Check that the app is SharkyClips-Setup-{version}.exe.
download.smart_note: Want to be sure? Every release has a .sha256 file. In PowerShell, Get-FileHash SharkyClips-Setup-{version}.exe must show the same number.
download.smart_alt: The Windows SmartScreen message: first click More info, then Run anyway

more.p: Settings → Updates → Check for updates. SharkyClips installs the new version when you are not using it. What's new.
Windows Settings → Apps → SharkyClips → Uninstall. It asks if you also want to delete your settings; your videos are kept.
There is a one-command installer for macOS and a manual install for developers. They are less tested than Windows. See the install guide.

faq.title: FAQ: SharkyClips questions and answers
faq.desc: Answers about SharkyClips: privacy, YouTube sign-in with your own Google project and the 100-user limit, the TikTok helper extension, low-end PCs and more.
faq.lead: Can't find your question? Ask us.

items.a: Yes. It is open source (MIT license). There is no subscription, no credits, no watermark and no ads. The AI runs on your own PC, so there is nothing to pay for.

items.q: Does SharkyClips upload my videos anywhere?
items.a: No. Everything runs on your PC: speech recognition, the AI, finding moments and making clips. There is no SharkyClips server and no tracking. Your videos only leave your PC when you share a clip to YouTube, TikTok or Instagram yourself. Details are in the privacy policy.

items.q: Why do I need my own Google project for YouTube? What is the 100-user limit?
items.a:
To upload to YouTube, an app needs a Google sign-in. Google limits a sign-in that it has not reviewed to 100 users in total (Google calls this the user cap). One shared sign-in for every SharkyClips user would be full very fast.

So the download has no shared Google sign-in. Instead you connect a free Google project of your own. Then the limit and the daily upload quota belong to you alone. It is free, needs no credit card and takes about 5 to 10 minutes, once.

items.q: How do I connect my own Google project?
items.a:
In SharkyClips: Settings → YouTube → Connect your own Google project. A guide opens the right Google pages for you:

  1. Create a project (any name).
  2. Turn on the YouTube Data API v3.
  3. Set up the consent screen (External) and add yourself as a test user.
  4. Create an OAuth client of the type Desktop app and download its file.
  5. Drop that file into SharkyClips and click Connect with Google.

Google may say the app is not verified: that is your own project, so you can continue. While the project is in Testing, Google ends the sign-in after 7 days; set it to In production to stay signed in. Full guide.

items.q: How do I set up the TikTok helper extension?
items.a:
The SharkyClips Helper is a small browser extension. It fills in your TikTok (and, if you want, Instagram) upload page and stops before Post.

  • Microsoft Edge, Opera, Opera GX, Brave: nothing to do. SharkyClips adds the Helper by itself when it opens the upload page.
  • Google Chrome: one setup step. SharkyClips shows a short guide: open chrome://extensions, turn on Developer mode, click Load unpacked and pick the folder SharkyClips shows you.
  • The first time, log in to TikTok in that browser window yourself. SharkyClips never sees your password.

The Helper only runs on TikTok and Instagram pages and only talks to SharkyClips on your PC. Without it, SharkyClips copies the caption for you and you post by hand.

items.q: Will it run on my PC? I don't have a gaming PC.
items.a: Yes. You need Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and 8 GB RAM. A GPU is not needed. On a PC without an NVIDIA GPU, SharkyClips picks Light mode by itself: a smaller speech model and a smaller AI that run on the processor. It is slower, but it works: a 17-minute video takes about 16 minutes on a small 2-core laptop. With an NVIDIA GPU it is much faster. See the system requirements.

items.q: Does it slow down my games?
items.a: No. In the default Silent mode SharkyClips pauses its heavy work while you play or watch something fullscreen and gives the game its graphics memory back. It goes on when you stop.

items.q: Windows says "Windows protected your PC". Is it safe?
items.a: That is SmartScreen warning about a new download that is not signed with a paid certificate yet. Click More info, then Run anyway. You can check the file with the .sha256 file of the release. Step by step.

Twitch, YouTube and Kick recordings (with their chat replay), most other video sites, or any video file on your PC. Long streams of several hours are fine. Only use videos you own or have the right to use.

items.q: Does it post to TikTok and Instagram for me?
items.a: SharkyClips prepares everything and the Helper fills in the upload page, but you click Post. Instagram is always shared by you. YouTube uploads can be automatic once you connect your own Google project.

items.q: Does it work on Mac or Linux?
items.a: Windows is the main platform, with a one-click installer. There is a one-command installer for macOS and a manual install for Linux and developers, but they are tested less. See the install guide.

items.q: How do I report a bug or suggest an idea?
items.a: In the app: Settings → About → Send feedback, or the same button in an error message. It opens a GitHub form with the app version and your system filled in, and nothing else. Or use the contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy policy: SharkyClips
privacy.desc: How SharkyClips handles your data: everything stays on your computer, there is no server and no tracking. YouTube API data use explained.
privacy.summary:
• SharkyClips runs on your computer. It has no server, no account and no tracking.
  • Your videos, transcripts, clips and YouTube data stay on your computer. The people who make SharkyClips never receive any of it.
  • The app only goes online for what you start: downloads, updates, and sharing to YouTube, TikTok or Instagram.
  • YouTube is optional. Disconnect in Settings, or remove access in your Google account.
